tools.title: Algebra Tiles Lab
tools.intro: Build expressions with tiles. Matching tiles combine, and a positive tile next to its negative makes a zero pair.
tools.description: Model expressions with x-tiles and unit tiles, combine like terms, cancel zero pairs, and see the distributive property as an area.

tools.title: Equation Balance Scale
tools.intro: An equation is a balance. Do something to one side or both, and watch whether it stays level.
tools.description: Solve equations on a balance scale: apply operations to one or both sides, see why both sides must change together, and meet equations with no solution or infinitely many.

tools.title: Inequality Number Line
tools.intro: Test numbers against an inequality and watch the graph. Then multiply both sides by a negative and see what has to happen to the symbol.
tools.description: Graph inequalities with open and closed circles, test points, and discover why multiplying or dividing by a negative flips the inequality symbol.

tools.title: Function Detector
tools.intro: Drag the vertical line across the graph. If it ever hits two points at once, the relation is not a function.
tools.description: Use the vertical line test on graphs and plotted points, link each graph to a mapping diagram, and read domain and range.

tools.title: Slope-Intercept Explorer
tools.intro: Change the slope and the y-intercept of y = mx + b and watch the line, the slope triangle and the table change together.
tools.description: Use sliders or drag points to change m and b in y = mx + b. See the slope triangle, the table and parallel or perpendicular lines update live.

tools.title: Systems Explorer
tools.intro: Two lines, one question: where do they meet? Change either line and watch the solution move, disappear or take over the whole line.
tools.description: Adjust two lines and watch their intersection. Find systems with one, no or infinitely many solutions, then switch on inequality shading.

tools.title: Exponent Rules Unpacker
tools.intro: Every exponent rule is a shortcut for counting factors. Unpack the powers, count the x's, and the rule writes itself.
tools.description: Expand powers into repeated factors to see why the product, quotient and power rules work, and follow a pattern to zero and negative exponents.

tools.title: Linear vs. Exponential Race
tools.intro: A linear function adds the same amount each step. An exponential function multiplies by the same amount. Race them.
tools.description: Compare y = a·bˣ with a linear function in a graph and a table. See constant differences versus constant ratios, growth versus decay, and the asymptote.

tools.title: Area Model Multiplier
tools.intro: Multiply two binomials by building a rectangle. Each piece of the rectangle is one part of the product.
tools.description: Build (ax + b)(cx + d) as a rectangle of tiles to see each partial product, where the middle term comes from, and why (x + 3)² is not x² + 9.

tools.title: Factor Rectangle Builder
tools.intro: Factoring is multiplying backwards. Find the rectangle that the tiles make, and its sides are the factors.
tools.description: Arrange x², x and unit tiles into a rectangle to factor a trinomial, then connect the factors to the zeros and x-intercepts of the parabola.

tools.title: Parabola Explorer
tools.intro: Change a, h and k in vertex form and watch the parabola move, flip and stretch. Switch to standard form to see the discriminant at work.
tools.description: Use vertex-form sliders for a, h and k, then standard form with the vertex, axis of symmetry, discriminant and number of x-intercepts.

tools.title: Line of Best Fit Lab
tools.intro: Fit a line by eye, then compare it with the regression line. Drag points around and watch the correlation change.
tools.description: Drag data points, fit a line by eye, compare it with the least-squares line, and see how residuals, outliers and r change.

tools.title: Transformation Lab
tools.intro: Pick a parent function, then stretch, reflect and shift it with a, b, h and k. The faint graph is the parent, so you can see every change.
tools.description: Transform six parent functions with a, b, h and k sliders and a ghost parent graph, and discover that the rules work the same way for every function.

tools.title: Feasible Region Optimizer
tools.intro: The shaded region holds every combination that follows the rules. Slide the profit line across it and find where the best value happens.
tools.description: Explore a linear programming problem: see the feasible region, slide the objective line, and discover why the maximum and minimum occur at vertices.

tools.title: Discriminant & Roots Explorer
tools.intro: Lift the parabola off the x-axis and watch its two real roots turn into a pair of complex roots on the complex plane.
tools.description: Change a, b and c, watch the discriminant, and follow the roots from the x-axis onto the complex plane as conjugate pairs.

tools.title: Zeros & Multiplicity Builder
tools.intro: Build a polynomial from its zeros. Choose how many times each zero repeats and watch the graph cross or bounce.
tools.description: Choose zeros, multiplicities and the leading coefficient to build a polynomial, and discover end behavior and how multiplicity shapes the graph at each zero.

tools.title: Exponential & Log Mirror
tools.intro: A logarithm undoes an exponential. Change the base and watch the two graphs mirror each other across y = x. Then compound interest more and more often and find e.
tools.description: See bˣ and log_b x as reflections across y = x with a base slider and matching points, then compound interest more often to discover e.

tools.title: Asymptote & Hole Explorer
tools.intro: Build a rational function from factors. A factor that cancels leaves a hole. A factor left in the denominator makes a vertical asymptote.
tools.description: Choose factors for the numerator and denominator to see holes, vertical asymptotes, horizontal asymptotes and x-intercepts appear on the graph.

tools.title: Sequence Builder
tools.intro: Arithmetic sequences add the same amount. Geometric sequences multiply by the same amount. Build both and watch their sums.
tools.description: Build arithmetic and geometric sequences with sliders, graph the terms and the running sum, and see when a geometric series converges.

tools.title: Conic Explorer
tools.intro: Change the numbers in the standard form of each conic and watch the shape, its center, its foci and its directrix move.
tools.description: Explore circles, ellipses, hyperbolas and parabolas from their standard-form equations, with centers, foci, vertices and the directrix drawn live.

tools.title: Unit Circle to Sine Wave
tools.intro: Drag the point around the unit circle. Its height becomes the sine graph and its horizontal position becomes cosine. Then transform the wave.
tools.description: Drag an angle around the unit circle to trace sine and cosine, read exact values, then change amplitude, period and shifts on the wave.

tools.title: Probability Simulation Lab
tools.intro: Flip coins and roll dice by the hundreds and watch the results settle toward the theoretical probability. Then explore the normal curve.
tools.description: Simulate coins and dice to compare experimental and theoretical probability, then use mean and standard deviation sliders to explore the empirical rule.
